row.evidence: Linear's pricing page lists "SAML and SCIM" only under Enterprise (Custom, annual billing only), and the SCIM docs say "SCIM provisioning is available on the Enterprise plan."
row.notes: Unchanged from June: Basic $10 and Business $16 per user/mo billed yearly; SAML, SCIM and the audit log are Enterprise-only (custom pricing, annual billing only). The June row's "~$192-240/u/yr" Enterprise estimate has no first-party source and was dropped. SCIM deactivation suspends the user and removes them from the next billing cycle; SCIM-created users bill only after first login. Roles via linear-owners/admins/guests push groups. GraphQL API (users, invites, suspend/unsuspend, role change) on every plan, including Free.

auth.token_source: Settings > Administration > Security > SAML & SCIM > enable SCIM > View configuration

deprovision.data_retained: Suspended users stay visible in the members list for history (issues they created or were assigned).
deprovision.notes: Suspension (active:false) removes the user from the next billing cycle. The GraphQL userSuspend mutation invalidates sessions; the SCIM doc does not say whether SCIM suspension does.

roles.how: Push groups named linear-owners (Enterprise), linear-admins and linear-guests; members get that workspace role. Default role is Member.

limitations.text: Only tested with Okta and OneLogin; other IdPs should work against the generic endpoint.
Once SCIM is enabled admins cannot manage users in Linear (a temporary manual override allows suspension).
SCIM-created users become billable only after their first login (since 14 Aug 2025).
Deleting a pushed group removes all members from the team and makes the team private; issues are unchanged.
Okta OIN Linear app is SAML-only per Linear; SCIM needs a separate custom Okta app.

capabilities.notes: create_user false: the schema has no userCreate mutation, only invites.

endpoints.purpose: Query users: all users in the workspace (filtering, sorting, pagination)
Mutation organizationInviteCreate: invite a user with role and teams
Mutation userUpdate: update a user profile
Mutation userSuspend: suspend a user and invalidate sessions
Mutation userUnsuspend: reactivate a suspended user
Mutation userRevokeAllSessions: revoke all sessions for a user
Mutation teamMembershipCreate: add a user to a team
Mutation teamMembershipDelete: remove a user from a team

rate_limits.text: 2,500 requests per hour per user with an API key (leaky bucket); 600/hour unauthenticated; complexity limits also apply.

limitations.text: No direct create-user mutation; users join via invite (organizationInviteCreate), SAML JIT or SCIM.
limitations.notes: Inferred from the mutations listed in the schema.

okta.notes: OIN page ticks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push and Schema Discovery and says the app uses GraphQL APIs for lifecycle management; Linear's own docs say the OIN app needs a separate custom app for SCIM. See conflicts.

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn tutorial for Linear found in the Entra saas-apps index; Linear documents SAML via a non-gallery "Create your own application". SCIM would use the generic endpoint (untested by Linear).

google.notes: Linear documents Google Workspace SAML via a custom SAML app; no Google provisioning documented.

onelogin.notes: Linear documents OneLogin's generic "SCIM Provisioner with SAML (SCIM v2 Enterprise, full SAML)" app; no dedicated OneLogin catalogue page loaded.

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud support sitemap has only a Linear AI Gateway article, no SSO/provisioning connector page found.

citations.quote: The integration enables secure single sign-on via SAML with universal logout and leverages GraphQL APIs to automate user lifecycle management, enabling user accounts to be created, updated, and deactivated seamlessly while assigning role-based access directly from Okta.

conflicts.text: Okta's OIN page (updated Aug 10 2026) says the Linear app automates create/update/deactivate and ticks SCIM, and describes it as using GraphQL APIs; Linear's SAML doc says the OIN integration currently requires a separate custom app for SCIM.

open_questions: SCIM base URL pattern, filtering, pagination, PUT vs PATCH and hard delete are not documented.
Whether SCIM suspension also ends active sessions is not stated (the GraphQL userSuspend does).
Whether the Okta OIN app provisions over SCIM or GraphQL is unclear (see conflicts).
Entra gallery and JumpCloud catalogue status not confirmed; no CSV user import documented.
